parameters.query: SELECT f.id, f.title, f.severity, f.description, f.rigId, f.createdAt, r.name as rigName, f.status, DATEDIFF(MINUTE, f.createdAt, GETDATE()) as minutesSinceCreated, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE eventId IS NULL AND title LIKE '%' + CAST(f.id AS NVARCHAR) + '%') as notificationsSent FROM failures f JOIN rigs r ON r.id = f.rigId WHERE f.isRemoved = 0 AND f.severity IN ('critical', 'high') AND f.status NOT IN ('closed', 'in_progress') AND f.createdAt >= DATEADD(HOUR, -48, GETDATE()) ORDER BY f.severity ASC, f.createdAt ASC
